# Parameter-landscape reports

| File | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `clustering_report.R` | Assembles the clustering HTML from manifests, tables, and existing figures. |
| `mode_parameter_contribution_report.R` | Assembles the mode-contribution HTML. |
| `dominant_ploidy_parameter_contribution_report.R` | Assembles the dominant-ploidy contribution HTML. |
| `parameter_landscape_report_utils.R` | Shared HTML escaping, table preview, file inventory, and page assembly helpers. |

Report code does not calculate statistics or draw plots.
